listing.summary: Explore Body Harvest: Recompiled and follow the upstream project for requirements, downloads and setup.

steps.title: Supply your original game files on first launch
steps.instruction: Choose your North American Body Harvest ROM in Load ROM on first launch; .z64, .n64 and .v64 are accepted by upstream. The game checks and remembers its own copy.

presentation.manual_preparation: Choose your North American Body Harvest ROM in Load ROM on first launch; .z64, .n64 and .v64 are accepted by upstream. The game checks and remembers its own copy. The ROM copy, saves, settings and supported mods use the upstream LocalAppData/BodyHarvestRecompiled folder. They remain outside Portcove backups. Keep the default upstream storage mode; use an external registration if you want portable.txt or customized runtime files. Existing external installations keep their files and update ownership. Play has not been tested through Portcove. Linux normally uses ~/.config/BodyHarvestRecompiled. Its SDL2, GTK3 and FreeType system dependencies remain upstream prerequisites. Play has not been tested through Portcove on Linux.
